title: Ridgeline Installation Services Visit Charges, Missed-Visit Credits and Delay Terms
content:
Field visits on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract carry program figures on both sides: a trip charge when a visit cannot proceed on the customer's side or is an out-of-warranty service visit, a credit when the installer misses a visit, a delay threshold and delay credit when installation starts late on Ridgeline's or the installer's side, and the number of missed visits after which the contract may be cancelled.

| Program | Program trip charge (USD) | Installer no-show credit (USD) | Delay threshold (calendar days after the original installation date) | Delay credit (USD) | Cancellation fee waived on a cancellation for such a delay | Customer-missed installation visits that allow cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | 89.00 | 50.00 | 7 | 50.00 | yes | 2 |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | 89.00 | 50.00 | 7 | 50.00 | yes | 2 |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | 129.00 | 75.00 | 14 | 100.00 | yes | 2 |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | 149.00 | 100.00 | 14 | 150.00 | yes | 2 |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | 149.00 | 100.00 | 14 | 150.00 | yes | 2 |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | 179.00 | 100.00 | 14 | 200.00 | yes | 2 |

## Reading the figures

- The **program trip charge** is the program's figure for an installer visit that cannot proceed because the customer is absent or the site is not ready, and for an out-of-warranty service visit.
- The **installer no-show credit** is the program's figure for a scheduled installation or warranty visit the installer missed.
- The **delay threshold** is the number of calendar days by which installation may start later than the original installation date, for reasons on Ridgeline's or the installer's side, before the delay remedies apply; the **delay credit** is the program's figure for such a delay.
- Every program waives the cancellation fee when the customer cancels because of a delay beyond its threshold.
- The last column is the number of installation visits missed by the customer after which Ridgeline may cancel the contract with the cancellation fee; it is 2 on every program.

## Program questions answered

**Which program has the highest trip charge?** Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation, at 179.00.

**How late may a carpet installation start before the delay terms come into play?** By 7 calendar days after the original installation date; the delay credit on that program is 50.00.
